speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation. Since you are a newborn, I will be speaking with your parents or guardian on your behalf to understand your condition. Can you tell me your baby's gestational age at birth and if there were any complications during delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful information; your baby is term, small for gestational age, and has had no prenatal care. Are there any specific physical symptoms you've noticed, such as poor feeding, lethargy, or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely patent ductus arteriosus), bluish non-blanching macules (syphilitic rash), cloudy lenses (congenital cataracts), and hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care is highly characteristic of congenital syphilis. I will request serology and imaging to confirm.

REQUEST TEST: VDRL_RPR, FTA-ABS, CBC, CSF_VDRL. REQUEST IMAGES: X_Ray_long_bones, Chest_XRay.
